subtitle: "Website Design and Styling"
---

## Introduction

CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to customize the appearance of websites, including typography, colors, spacing, and layout.

SCSS (Sassy CSS) extends CSS by allowing developers to use variables, nesting, and reusable styling patterns.

These technologies help create websites that are visually consistent, accessible, and professional.

## Why Website Styling Matters

Website styling is important because it influences how visitors interact with digital content.

Effective styling improves:

- Readability and information hierarchy
- Website navigation
- Brand consistency
- Mobile responsiveness
- User experience

## CSS in Quarto

Quarto websites can use external CSS files to customize their appearance.

For example, a custom stylesheet can change heading colors:

```css
h1 {
  color: #17365d;
  font-weight: 700;
}
```

This makes headings visually consistent across the website.

## SCSS in Quarto

SCSS provides additional features that make styling more efficient.

For example, SCSS variables allow developers to define and reuse colors:

```scss
$primary: #17365d;
$secondary: #607d8b;
```

SCSS also supports nested rules:

```scss
.navbar {
  font-weight: 600;

  a {
    text-decoration: none;
  }
}
```

## How I Customized My Portfolio

I applied custom CSS styling to my Quarto portfolio to create a professional appearance.

My design choices emphasize:

1. Consistent typography
2. Clear navigation
3. Professional colors
4. Readable page layouts
5. Organized content presentation

## CSS vs. SCSS

| Feature | CSS | SCSS |
|---|---|---|
| Styling | Yes | Yes |
| Variables | Native custom properties | SCSS variables |
| Nesting | Supported in modern CSS | Supported |
| Quarto integration | External stylesheet | Theme customization |
| Compilation | No preprocessor required | Requires Sass compilation |

## Conclusion

Learning CSS and SCSS provides greater control over Quarto website design.

These skills are useful for creating professional portfolios, marketing reports, and interactive analytics presentations.
